Gemini FREE for 18 months — the Jio trick

This is Jio's official offer with Google: 18 months FREE Google AI Pro (Gemini Pro), worth ₹35,100. It is free for 18 months — not unlimited forever.

Who can claim it:

  • You have a Jio SIM and you are 18 or older
  • An active Jio Unlimited 5G plan of ₹349 or above — keep it active for the full 18 months
  • One claim per mobile number

How to claim it in the MyJio app:

  1. Open the MyJio app
  2. Tap the "Google Gemini Offer" banner
  3. Tap Claim Offer
  4. Sign in with your Gmail to link it — done, Gemini Pro is active
